Classification: High Clan

Called the Fiends, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} have ruled Eastern Europe since time immemorial, tied by blood-pacts to the old gods of the earth and to the land itself. Their lorekeepers, the koldun, tell how the clan founder left the Second City to carve out his own dominion in the mountains. The Dark Medieval finds the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} beset on all sides: the theft of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} blood that created the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} has provoked open war, Germanic @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} exploit the conflict to invade pagan enclaves in Lithuania and Livonia, and internal power struggles and hereditary feuds sap the clan's unity.

Disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Vicissitude

Advantage: All Tzimisce start with one free Occult Ability Trait, and may learn the first two levels of any Lore Ability with ease (Storyteller discretion).

Disadvantage: A Tzimisce must sleep surrounded by at least two handfuls of soil from their grave or native homeland. Each day without such rest they suffer a one-Trait penalty on all challenges, removed one-for-one after resting with the proper earth.

Organization: A rigid hierarchy of elders ruling childer who scheme and serve to curry favor, bound by respect for elders, personal honor, obedience to family, and devotion to the homeland.

Suggested Viae: Heaven, Kings. Some follow the cult-like Road of Metamorphosis.
